verdicts.en: Shaykh of Islam, hadith master, jurist and ascetic.

bio: The imam of Syria and founder of a school of law followed there and in al-Andalus for generations. Both canonical copies of the Abu Hurayra chain of this hadith (al-Tirmidhi and Ibn Majah) pass through him, and his own students disagreed about whether he named Qurra, so the critics asked carefully what he actually said.
